wrong-key nulls: vigenere-short-key, atbash-shift, totient-stream are outside the 'wrong key = uniform string' claim (a partially matching periodic key leaves structure; a wrong atbash/shift key is a substitution of the plaintext; a wrong totient start is another offset of one non-uniform stream); their KS statistics are reported, not asserted, and the finite families also report the count above the Gumbel bar at N = their key count

wrong-key nulls of the wb scorer carry the cipher window's own mask while null (a) averages over sampled masks, so their KS statistic measures the mask dependence of section 6 as well; the 'wrong key = uniform string' claim is for the nb scorers

the power rows measure the scorer on rigid-exact decodes (the true key of an additive family returns the plaintext); interrupters and anti-repeat skips are measured in the beam cells only, at L [120, 240] with lp-ngram3-heldout, kn4-lp-heldout, kn4-cicada; no kn6/kn8 preset pairs with a beam decoder
mt19937-py27 streams (the template lane's generator) share the combine/view code path of the two stream generators measured and are not drawn here
kn8-cicada-wb: adjudication/report-only; its null depends on the window's mask (section 6) and no lane names it with any decoder
no GPU: every number is the numpy path; the CUDA kernel is Phase 3
no key space of the unsolved pages is searched here: this is an instrument report, not a lane; coverage of LP2 is 0 of every space

families.name: vigenere-short-key
families.note: period 8-13; a wrong key of the same period matches 1/29 of its symbols

families.name: atbash-shift
families.note: 58 keys: shift 0-28 with or without atbash; every wrong key is a monoalphabetic substitution of the plaintext, not a uniform string, so the family is outside the equality claim; its 57 wrong keys are enumerated

families.name: totient-stream
families.note: phi(p) = p - 1 over the primes from start (10,000 starts); a wrong key is another offset of the same deterministic stream (p - 1 mod 29 is never 28 past p = 29), so the family is outside the equality claim; wrong keys drawn without replacement

conditionals.key_space_swept: none of LP2: the families (section 2) are the plant/decoy generators of the measurement; no seed range of any lane was searched
conditionals.decoder_transition_model: rigid (one key symbol per rune) for every power row; beam, beam-skip and beam-skip-int at width 8 (presets.DECODER_PARAMS) in the beam cells, with the three dense scorers only
conditionals.adjudicator_register: the scorers listed in section 0: Cicada-English, general English, Latin, Old English and vowel-dropped English registers (kn8-*), plus the Phase 1 order-3 baselines; power is reported per register x scorer (section 4)
conditionals.standing_conditional: every later negative is English-register-first: a Latin or other non-English plaintext is detected only to the power this table measures for that register (SESSION_PROMPT.md section B)
reopens_if: a scorer's fingerprint changes (a refit, a corpus rebuild that moves the split)
